capabilities: Import agent session files (.jsonl) as formatted transcript notes
Browse and search sessions in a picker and sidebar rack
Re-import changed sessions without creating duplicates
Redact secrets and save transcript images as vault attachments
disambiguation: Despite the cassette theme, it records nothing itself; it converts existing agent session log files into notes.
extras: Desktop-only, since it reads files outside the vault with Node's fs. Makes no network requests. Redaction of secrets is described as best-effort. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Agent coding tools write raw .jsonl session logs in hidden home-folder folders that are hard to read and never reach your notes.

relations.evidence: Pop a Claude Code, ChatGPT / Codex, or Pi session into the deck
Import agent transcripts (Claude Code, ChatGPT / Codex, Pi) as readable notes
ChatGPT / Codex, Pi, or Auto-detect. Auto-detect reads the first lines of each file.

requires.name: Claude Code, ChatGPT / Codex, or Pi session files on disk

summary: Imports Claude Code, ChatGPT / Codex, and Pi session transcripts into the vault as readable, titled Markdown notes.
